rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; two datasets from separate institutions: CamCAN (Cambridge, UK) and UCLA phenomics (Los Angeles, USA)
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "The data utilised is from two existing datasets: CamCAN ageing and UCLA phenomics" / "A set of HBR models were trained on healthy participants data from both the UCLA and CamCAN datasets"
rci1_using_msad.location: Lawn2024.pdf.md: Fig. 1 caption / Methods / Normative modelling

rci2_using_epd.detail: CamCAN (Cam-CAN) is an EPD used for normative model training; UCLA phenomics is in-house/public but not in the EPD list

rci3_epd_name.detail: CamCAN healthy ageing dataset used in the reference cohort for normative model training; UCLA phenomics is publicly available but not in the confirmed EPD list

rci5_n.detail: Training phase HC; 70/30 train/test split applied to total HC (N=607): CamCAN 346 + UCLA 78 = 424 training subjects
rci5_n.supporting_text: "utilising a 70/30 train test split... resulting in CamCAN = 346/150 and UCLA = 78/33 train/test subdivisions"

rci6_sex.detail: Training phase sex breakdown not reported; overall HC sex reported as CamCAN M/F=255/241 (N=496) and UCLA M/F=60/51 (N=111), but training-specific sex counts are not stated
rci6_sex.supporting_text: "Following quality control exclusions, imaging data of a total of 607 healthy subjects (CamCAN: N =496, Mean age (SD) = 52.3 (18.3), M/F = 255/241; UCLA: N =111, Mean age (SD) = 31.2 (8.7), M/F = 60/51) were included in the analysis."

rci7_age.detail: Training phase age statistics not reported; overall HC ages reported as CamCAN mean=52.3 (SD=18.3) and UCLA mean=31.2 (SD=8.7), but training-specific age stats are not stated
rci7_age.supporting_text: "Following quality control exclusions, imaging data of a total of 607 healthy subjects (CamCAN: N =496, Mean age (SD) = 52.3 (18.3), M/F = 255/241; UCLA: N =111, Mean age (SD) = 31.2 (8.7), M/F = 60/51) were included in the analysis."
